basil-the-great.oneLineEn: One of the Cappadocian Fathers; shaped Greek patristics via Trinitarian theology, creation exegesis, and monastic rules.

gregory-of-nazianzus.oneLineEn: One of the Cappadocian Fathers; his Five Theological Orations fixed Eastern Orthodox Trinitarian expression.

gregory-of-nyssa.oneLineEn: One of the Cappadocian Fathers; deepened Greek patristics via mystical theology, epektasis, and anthropology.

john-of-damascus.oneLineEn: Byzantine doctrine systemizer linking Aristotelian logic and Orthodoxy via Fountain of Knowledge and icon defense.
keywordsEn: Exact Exposition of the Orthodox Faith

mani.oneLineEn: Sasanian founder of Manichaeism; cast light-dark dualism, soteriology, and ascetic ethics in self-authored scriptures.

maximus-the-confessor.oneLineEn: Byzantine theological synthesizer taking up Greek patristics via the Ambigua, dyothelitism, and cosmic Christology.

pseudo-dionysius.oneLineEn: Pseudepigraphic (~500) negative theology, Divine Names, and hierarchy shaping Eastern and Latin medieval thought.

zoroaster.oneLineEn: Ancient Iranian prophet of Zoroastrianism; good-evil choice, asha, and last judgment source pre-Islamic Persian thought.

michael-psellos.oneLineEn: Byzantine polymath joining classical and medieval Greek thought via Platonic revival, court notes, and encyclopedism.

aleksei-khomyakov.oneLineEn: Core Slavophile theorist who framed freedom, community, and Orthodox tradition through sobornost.

alexander-herzen.oneLineEn: Russian Westernizer and exile thinker known for personal freedom, peasant socialism, and Russia's modernization problem.

buddhadasa.oneLineEn: Modern Thai Buddhist thinker linking reform and politics via dependent origination, anapanasati, and Dhammic socialism.

buddhaghosa.oneLineEn: Core systematizer of Theravada Pali commentary; Visuddhimagga unites sila-samadhi-panna, Abhidhamma, and the path.

chen-liang.oneLineEn: Southern Song Yongkang figure known for practical accomplishment and the Wang-Ba / yi-li debate with Zhu Xi.

chen-xianzhang.oneLineEn: Founder of the Ming Baisha School, stressing self-attainment of mind-substance and quiet-sitting cultivation.

dao-an.oneLineEn: Eastern Jin monk who advanced scripture catalogs, sangha norms, and the autonomy of Chinese Buddhism.

daoxuan.oneLineEn: Tang Vinaya master and Buddhist historian known for Vinaya learning and compilation of monk biographies.

dong-zhongshu.oneLineEn: Western Han Confucian who joined Spring and Autumn learning, yin-yang Five Phases, and dynastic politics.
keywordsEn: Luxuriant Dew of the Spring and Autumn Annals

fang-yizhi.oneLineEn: Ming-Qing thinker bridging Confucianism, Buddhism, Daoism, and natural knowledge.
keywordsEn: Notes on the Principles of Things
empirical measurement and penetrating the subtle

fyodor-dostoevsky.oneLineEn: Russian novelist-thinker who carried religion, freedom, evil, and redemption in literary form.
